email_body:
Dear Orange Cyberdefense team,

I'm writing to apply for the Marketing Business Partner - Content role in Wijnegem. Your focus on translating cybersecurity expertise into clear, market-relevant stories resonates with my own approach: I work where SEO, content and web meet, building narratives that are both technically sound and audience-focused.

In my current roles, I handle on-page SEO, keyword research and content for client websites, using tools like Semrush, Ahrefs and Google Analytics to track results. I've built and optimized sites in WordPress, implemented structured data and schema, and used AI tools to automate repetitive work. I'm comfortable operating strategically and hands-on, and I enjoy collaborating with stakeholders to turn business input into concrete marketing actions.

I'm fluent in English and have working proficiency in Dutch, with a technical background that helps me grasp complex topics quickly. I'd welcome the chance to contribute to Orange Cyberdefense's mission of building a safer digital society.

Thank you for your consideration.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Orange Cyberdefense team,

I'm excited to apply for the Marketing Business Partner - Content role in Wijnegem. The opportunity to translate cybersecurity expertise into compelling, market-relevant stories for the Belgian market aligns perfectly with my experience at the intersection of SEO, content and web.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketer roles, I've built and optimized websites for traditional and AI-powered search, written SEO content that ranks, and used AI tools and code to automate repetitive work. I've implemented structured data and schema, managed CMS content in WordPress, and run technical SEO audits that measurably improved site health. For example, I built and optimized mirook.com, implementing JSON-LD schema and an llms.txt file, and ran iterative audits that raised the site's search-health score. I've also collaborated with clients to understand their needs and translate them into concrete marketing initiatives, from keyword research to content creation.

What draws me to this role is the blend of strategy and execution. I enjoy acting as a go-to-market partner, capturing market needs and shaping narratives that resonate with sales priorities. My technical background in computer science and front-end development gives me a solid foundation for understanding complex cybersecurity topics and translating them into clear, credible messaging. I'm comfortable working cross-functionally and bringing structure to business input, and I'm proactive in driving initiatives independently.

I'm fluent in English and have working proficiency in Dutch (writing B1, speaking A2+), and I'm eager to further develop my Dutch in a professional context. I'm based in Zwijndrecht, close to Wijnegem, and available for a full-time role.

I'd welcome the opportunity to discuss how my skills in content, SEO and storytelling can contribute to Orange Cyberdefense's mission of building a safer digital society. Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
• Content & storytelling: SEO blog and website content writing, translating complex topics into clear narratives for diverse audiences.
• Go-to-market support: keyword research, on-page SEO and content strategies that align with client needs and drive organic growth.
• Cross-functional collaboration: experience working with clients and teams to capture requirements and deliver marketing initiatives.
• Hands-on execution: building and optimizing WordPress sites, managing CMS content, and coordinating campaigns from idea to delivery.
• Technical fluency: background in computer science and front-end development, enabling quick grasp of cybersecurity concepts.
